Manufacturing audit: do not order

The five-board audit found overlapping U5/C26 solder lands, 14 incomplete courtyards, GaN mask/paste and placement-origin issues, and a mismatch between the native stack and the available factory construction. A handling panel and ferrite-fitting operation are not approved. Full turnkey assembly is not confirmed.

Planning allowance: $400–650 for five boards, excluding shipping, taxes, ferrite-fitting labor and functional testing. This is not a supplier quote. All 43 electronic codes currently cover five fitted boards before attrition.

Complete manufacturing findingsIssue registerCost breakdown

Manufacturing repairs and copper pours

A11 repairs the GaN land/mask/stencil, the LDO bypass overlap, undersized courtyards and orientation marks. The controller, divider and feedback placements are regrouped and aligned. The native stack and magnetic model now use the observed JLC construction: 1.655 mm, 70 µm outer / 61 µm inner copper.

The final 50 stitching vias each connect at least two ground fills. Pours are named, isolated islands are removed, switching-node projection voids are retained and connector pads use thermal reliefs. All checked drive and control/sense paths have adjacent return copper outside their own via antipads.

Factory acceptance and electrical release remain open. Manufacturing CAD repairs are complete; ferrite fitting, placement-model review, special processes and powered qualification still require closure.

Shorter output distribution

The 2 mm output rail now connects the nearby capacitor bank directly to the output port. Source-derived centerline measurements; no claim of extracted inductance or measured EMI.

Compact, with bench access

Opposing 5.08 mm headers accept removable screw-terminal plugs. Bench leads can be changed without soldering a harness. Six bare probe pads provide VIN/PGND, VOUT/SGND and V5/AGND measurement pairs.

Four M3 holes reuse the flyback example's exact exposed-substrate edge footprint: 3.2 mm drill, 6.4 mm mask opening and 10 mm exclusion on all copper layers. The compact board uses a 55 × 47 mm pattern, different from the flyback's spacing.

Pin 2 is positive and pin 1 is return on both power ports. Mark the mating input and output plugs: the identical connector family does not prevent a cable swap.

Headers overhang the PCB. Plugs, wire bend radius, removal space and the underside ferrite add to the assembly envelope. Renders show unmated headers; the area reduction describes the PCB only.

DimensionsMIT PER studyUnderside

Look through the winding stack

The 4:2:2 transformer has repeatable PCB windings, paralleled secondary layers and a stock ELP22 core. It needs no bobbin or hand-wound coil. The tradeoffs include eight heavy-copper layers, filled vias, termination loss and coupling/capacitance that still require measurement.

Parts and assembly

$23.42 electronics + $0.39 mating plugs + about $6.88 core/clips = $30.69 parts allowance. Catalog snapshots exclude PCB, assembly, setup, attrition, minimum quantities, tax and shipping.

The board headers are C3697; two matching C71370 screw plugs are external accessories, not PCB placements. All 75 purchased PCB parts map to 43 stocked catalog codes in the snapshot. L2 has only 39 units in that snapshot.

Sourcing and drawingsPCB BOMTop assembly drawingMating plugsDigiKey core/clip list

Turnkey acceptance remains open. JLCPCB must review the files, exact stack, filled/capped vias, placement rotations and through-hole solder process. Its installation of the DigiKey core halves and clips has not been agreed. No order has been placed.

Checked CAD, unqualified hardware

ERC, DRC, connectivity, schematic parity, pin-net mapping and BOM/CPL agreement pass. Independent geometry checks screen winding contacts and junctions. A clean-directory rebuild reproduces the routing and pad geometry.

First-harmonic calculations are a screening model, not a switching simulation. The 60 W target still needs magnetics, startup, no-load behavior, current limit, OVP, ZVS, synchronous rectifier timing, control-loop and thermal validation. Functional isolation only.
